name: ESO 280-SC06 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 280-SC06, a globular cluster in the Milky Way, seen by Hubble.
label: eso2806-hubble
story: A faint globular cluster, one of the least luminous and most metal-poor known in the Milky Way. Its stars suggest it was once far more massive, before tides pulled much of it apart.

claims.text: ESO 280-6 is a globular cluster targeted by the Hubble Missing Globular Clusters Survey
ESO 280-SC06 is one of the least luminous and most metal-poor Milky Way globular clusters
ESO280-SC06 may be the most metal-poor globular cluster known in the Milky Way
ESO 280-SC06 is a formerly massive, tidally disrupted globular cluster
